Advisory (not usage-derived, because no CPU/memory series could be read): add explicit resources to Deployment api-gateway's nginx container — a starting point for a small static/API nginx pod is requests cpu=100m, memory=128Mi and limits cpu=500m, memory=256Mi — and adjust only after measuring real usage once Prometheus data is reachable.

For a pod named api-gateway, consider raising spec.replicas above the current 1 and adding a PodDisruptionBudget, so a single node or pod disruption does not remove the only serving replica.

Decide whether the 204 responses on GET /health and /api/v1/* paths are expected for this workload, and if not, inspect the server behind the gateway before treating them as an incident.
Consider adding requests/limits, probes, a pinned image digest, and more than one replica to Deployment api-gateway, as advisory hardening rather than a fix for an observed failure.
